name: Marylin and Sarah at the Self-Defense Class
description: Marylin and Sarah sit against the wall of a gymnasium, watching a self-defense class in progress. Women in IMPACT-Personal Safety T-shirts take turns practicing responses to simulated attacks by heavily padded instructors. One woman, Lilly, panics at the sight of the approaching 'mugger' and runs out of the room, prompting stifled laughter from Marylin and Sarah until they are silenced by disapproving looks from others. As the instructors comfort the upset student, Marylin turns to Sarah and talks about a conflict at work with a man named Massey, who has rejected every proposal put forward by their colleague Ruth. She says she doesn’t understand his behavior, adding that even Rex seemed confused by it. She suspects Massey might have a personal grudge against her. Sarah asks where things stand, and Marylin replies that if Massey doesn’t change his position, they’ll end up in court. Then she reveals that Massey called and invited her to dinner. Sarah reacts with surprise. When her turn comes, Marylin stands, walks calmly to the center of the gym, and begins the exercise. The mugger grabs her from behind, and she immediately stomps on his foot, spins around, drives her elbow into his face, and knees him in the groin. The class cheers. The instructor praises her but reminds her she forgot to yell 'no.' Marylin turns to the attacker and calmly says, 'No.' Later, in an elegant restaurant, Miles rises as Marylin enters. He greets her as Mrs. Rexroth and thanks her for coming. The maitre d' pulls out her chair. Marylin says she was curious—and hungry. Miles orders a bottle of Chateau Margaux '57, glancing at the wine list. She asks if Rex is paying, and Miles replies, 'Isn’t everything?' He looks at her and says her husband mentioned her beauty, but he was unprepared. Marylin quotes, 'Dismiss your vows, your feigned tears, your flattery, for where a heart is hard, they make no battery.' Miles leans back, resting his chin on his fist, and asks if she has a hard heart. She responds, 'Did you see the tape?'

description: Marylin Rexroth sits on the witness stand, her posture composed, her expression carrying a quiet sorrow. Ruth places a hand on her shoulder before stepping back.
